findings.evidence: MyApplication.kt enables FirebaseCrashlytics and FirebaseAnalytics performance diagnostics and crash collection gated by hasAcceptedPrivacy preference, which is disclosed and opted-into via WelcomeScreen.kt AlertDialog ('Mave also collects app interactions and analytics data, as well as crash logs').
findings.recommendation: Ensure that the Play Store Data Safety form declares collection of Performance Diagnostics (crash logs and app performance data) for Analytics and App Functionality purposes.

findings.evidence: No raw credit, debit, or bank account numbers are collected, stored, or transmitted by the app codebase or Firebase backend. Subscriptions and payments are handled out-of-band via Google Play Billing API or Stripe web checkout.
findings.recommendation: No declaration required in Play Store Data Safety form for credit/debit bank account numbers as the app does not collect or process raw financial account numbers directly.
